LOG_PATH={5}

log() {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$1" >> "$LOG_PATH"
}

fail() {
    log "failed: $1"
    if [ -n "${MOUNT_POINT:-}" ]; then
        hdiutil detach "$MOUNT_POINT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    osascript -e 'display alert "nfprogress" message "Failed to install update. Details: '"$LOG_PATH"'"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    exit 1
}

log "waiting for application process $PARENT_PID"
while kill -0 "$PARENT_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 0.5
done
sleep 1

WORK_DIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}nfprogress-update.XXXXXX") || fail "Could not create temporary folder."
ZIP_PATH="$WORK_DIR/update.zip"
EXTRACT_DIR="$WORK_DIR/extract"
mkdir -p "$EXTRACT_DIR" || fail "Could not create extraction folder."

log "downloading $DOWNLOAD_URL"
curl -fL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 2 -o "$ZIP_PATH" "$DOWNLOAD_URL" || fail "Failed to download the update archive."
ditto -x -k "$ZIP_PATH" "$EXTRACT_DIR" || unzip -q "$ZIP_PATH" -d "$EXTRACT_DIR" || fail "Failed to unpack zip archive."

NEW_APP=$(find "$EXTRACT_DIR" -maxdepth 4 -name "$TARGET_NAME" -type d -print -quit)
if [ -z "$NEW_APP" ]; then
    NEW_APP=$(find "$EXTRACT_DIR" -maxdepth 4 -name "*.app" -type d -print -quit)
fi

if [ -z "$NEW_APP" ]; then
    DMG_PATH=$(find "$EXTRACT_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -name "*.dmg" -type f -print -quit)
    if [ -n "$DMG_PATH" ]; then
        MOUNT_OUTPUT=$(hdiutil attach "$DMG_PATH" -nobrowse -readonly 2>>"$LOG_PATH") || fail "Failed to mount dmg."
        MOUNT_POINT=$(printf '%s\n' "$MOUNT_OUTPUT" | awk '/\/Volumes\// {print substr($0, index($0, "/Volumes/")); exit}')
        [ -n "$MOUNT_POINT" ] || fail "The dmg mount point could not be determined."
        NEW_APP=$(find "$MOUNT_POINT" -maxdepth 2 -name "$TARGET_NAME" -type d -print -quit)
        if [ -z "$NEW_APP" ]; then
            NEW_APP=$(find "$MOUNT_POINT" -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" -type d -print -quit)
        fi
    fi
fi

[ -n "$NEW_APP" ] || fail "The .app was not found in the update archive."

BACKUP_PATH="$TARGET_PATH.old"
rm -rf "$BACKUP_PATH"
if [ -d "$TARGET_PATH" ]; then
    mv "$TARGET_PATH" "$BACKUP_PATH" || fail "Failed to remove the old application."
fi
ditto "$NEW_APP" "$TARGET_PATH" || {
    rm -rf "$TARGET_PATH"
    if [ -d "$BACKUP_PATH" ]; then
        mv "$BACKUP_PATH" "$TARGET_PATH"
    fi
    fail "Failed to copy new version."
}

fi
rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"

log "updated $TARGET_PATH"
open "$TARGET_PATH"

Daily in-game goal

At the beginning of each writing day, three sentences of different types and complexities are created. The first is selected automatically; the other can be chosen before completion for 15 inspiration.

  • Daily volume: write the specified number of characters. The base is 80% of the average result of productive days over the previous 14 days, rounded to the nearest hundred and limited to the range of 500–5,000. If there is no story, the base is 1,000.
  • Session rhythm: complete 1–3 successful writing sessions.
  • Editor’s day: complete 1–2 successful sessions with the intention “Edit text”.

Difficulty “Easy”, “Normal”, or “Hard” changes the goal and reward. After completion, coins, experience, and 10 inspiration points are awarded. “Challenge Focus,” the Explorer bonus, and relics increase coins and experience.

Completed goals cannot be changed. A new day creates a new set and resets unfinished progress. The “new goal token” switches to the next option for free.

Do not confuse: this is a game challenge, not a cumulative project goal by deadline.

A stage is a nested project with its own name, goal, current value, records, deadline, daily plan, streak and synchronization. All stages use the unit of measure of the parent project.

  • The total goal and scope of the parent are equal to the sum of the goals and scopes of the stages; The parent's fields become read-only.
  • If the parent does not have a deadline, their displayed goal for today is the sum of the daily milestone goals. If the parent has a deadline, the total plan is calculated for the sum of the stages.
  • When adding a deadline to a parent, the longest streak of the stage is transferred to the project, and the streaks of the stages are cleared. Their deadlines remain the same.
  • Converting a regular project to a milestone project brings history, progress, and synchronization into the first stage. The inverse transformation combines records over time and recalculates a single progress.
  • A regular step cannot be archived, but it can be edited, completed, or deleted individually. Completion of the entire project also completes all unfinished stages.
